title: Making Our Own PHP Web Server - Part 1: HTTP From Scratch
author: Stefan Bogdanescu
excerpt: Build a basic HTTP server in PHP using socket programming. Learn how to handle TCP connections, parse HTTP requests, serve responses, and understand what happens under the hood.
